Job Description:

The Role and Impact We are looking for an enthusiastic Development Tools Software Engineer to join our debug tools team. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize software debug tools that support critical workflows, enabling engineers to create and integrate Intel silicon and software into impactful products. Your contributions will directly enhance tools used across Intel's engineering ecosystem, playing a vital role in delivering cutting-edge solutions to our customers. Business group Intel's Debug and Trace Tools Engineering team drives innovation by creating high-quality software debug tools and systems that support product design, manufacturing, validation, and integration. By utilizing modern development methodologies and secure coding practices, the team contributes to Intel's broader mission of delivering world-class silicon and software solutions. Through collaboration and expertise, the group supports Intel's commitment to advancing technology while fostering an inclusive and empowering work environment. Key Responsibilities - Design and implement robust software tools, including debuggers, for engineering workflows and silicon validation. - Utilize modern programming languages and development methodologies to create efficient, secure, and scalable systems. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and ensure seamless integration of tools into existing workflows. - Optimize software tools for high performance and reliability across diverse use cases. - Debug and resolve software issues, ensuring the tools meet production-quality standards. - Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines to streamline development and testing processes. - Support the adoption of Agile practices within the team to foster collaboration and continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field with 3+ years of industry experience; OR Master's degree with 2+ years of professional experience; OR PhD with no prior professional experience.
- Proficiency in modern programming languages such as C++
- Hands-on experience with version control systems
- Knowledge of embedded systems and hardware architectures.
- Solid analytical skills and ability to work in Agile development teams.
- Experience with configuring Linux and Windows systems.
- Knowledge about Open-Source Software.
- Advanced English.
- Understanding AI and HPC SW stacks
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience developing tools such as compilers or debuggers like gdb.
- Knowledge of OS internals, particularly Linux
- Understanding of testing frameworks and methodologies.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
Join us in accelerating innovation and building tools that empower engineers around the globe.

Please note this is a temporary position from 6 up to 24 months.

Artificial Intelligence and machine learning are at the cutting edge when it comes to shaping next-gen mobility in areas like automated driving. But it takes real intellectual leadership and expertise to identify and then harness the AI trends and technologies that will transform the way people travel for good.

We are an international team of experts shaping the future of intelligent mobility by developing and refining edge GenAI models for the BMW Intelligent Personal Assistant. Together, we deliver customer impact through innovative model engineering and robust data pipelines.

You select and adapt base models for voice assistant and intelligence tasks.

Skilled in building evaluation suites and performing statistical analysis of model behaviour.
Practical knowledge of edge device constraints such as RAM, bandwidth, cache, and cold start.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the digital architecture team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working student - AI & Semantic Data Integration for Digital Transformation Architecture (d/f/m)

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know work of a digital architect focusing on the frontier of AI? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the digital architecture team as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Ottobrunn in the Munich area
- Start: November 2026
- Duration: 12 -24 months

The mission of the architecture unit is to plan and design state of the art, sustainable and secured enterprise digital solutions for our customers, partners and everybody and you can be part of this exciting journey. The transformation programs architecture team, which you will become part of, has the particular mission to define the future to-be target architecture for a full digital continuity of all key value streams of the company. This includes the design of the major enterprise platforms like ALM, PLM, ERP, CRM, MOM/MES but also technology watch and application of emerging technologies. You will specifically focus on the intersection of AI and Data: exploring Agentic Coding, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and building a unified Semantic Layer (using Neo4j) to enable seamless data integration between architect management tools like Aris, Alfabet, and the Data Catalog.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Travelling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Contribute to the research and exploration of Agentic AI workflows and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for enterprise use cases.
- Contribute to the development of a Semantic Layer using Graph Databases (Neo4j) to integrate data across Aris, Alfabet, and the Data Catalog.
- Contribute to the design of automated data pipelines and semantic mappings between disparate enterprise architecture tools.
- Contribute to the deployment and orchestration of AI-driven services and integration layers within OpenShift environments.
- Contribute to the modeling of the digital architecture on different layers (business, functional, data, technical) to support the semantic integration.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of computer science, data science, engineering, or an equivalent field of study.
- First practical experience in Python programming or working with Graph Databases (e.g., Neo4j) is highly desirable.
- Interest in cutting-edge AI developments, specifically LLM Agents, RAG, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud-native environments like OpenShift is a plus.
- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and data integration patterns is desirable.
- Fluent in German and English.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrolment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and applyonline (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

In a Nutshell

As a

Maintenance Engineer (m/f/d)
, you’ll work in our soon to open Fulfilment Center in Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) with the latest intralogistics systems from top brands like Apollo, Qimarox, and Regal Rexnord. You’ll be responsible for keeping our Material Handling Equipment running at peak performance, solving malfunctions independently, and implementing improvements. Your insight and initiative are valued, and you’ll coach junior colleagues to elevate the team, ensuring tens of thousands of orders reach families on time every day. During your shift, you take full responsibility for the service and maintenance of our systems.

Troubleshooting malfunctions: You detect and resolve both electrical and mechanical issues in technical systems, working closely with our operational supervisors.

Collaboration with suppliers: For complex problems, you work directly with machine suppliers to find solutions.

Analysis and improvement: You analyze malfunctions, prevent recurrence, and implement structural improvements.

Preventive maintenance: You perform scheduled preventive maintenance to ensure maximum system availability.

You hold a Ausbildung and/or a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g., mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, mechatronics, automation, etc.)
You have 7+ years of experience in a technical or maintenance role
You have hands-on knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, including measurement and camera systems
You have been working with software tools such as CMMS and/or ICS/SCADA tools
You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating in a team
At the same time, you are independent, take initiative, and solve problems in a goal-oriented way
You're fluent in English, German

Smart Commute: Choose the way you move. You will get a company car (with private use) and can make use of our “Lease-a-Bike” program.

Time to recharge: With 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 40-hour workweek in a shift system), you can strike the perfect balance between work and leisure.

Fuel for Winners: Enjoy fresh, free breakfasts and lunches every day in our Fulfilment Center, along with all the snacks and fruit you need to stay fueled.

Kickstart your career: Join our international team in an environment that fosters real growth and an “Act like an Owner” mentality. Here, you’ll have the chance to drive projects independently, test new ideas, and level up through specialized Lepaya trainings to see firsthand how your work makes an impact.

Sustainability at Core: Be part of the revolution. You’ll contribute to a greener future through our 100% electric fleet and a business model designed to drastically reduce food waste.

The Essentials: We provide the tools for success, including a laptop and phone, and access to exclusive Corporate Benefits discounts for travel, tech and more.

Unforgettable Moments: From our legendary annual ski trip, our massive Christmas parties, to parties featuring our very own Picnic band, we make sure our milestones are celebrated in style.

Well-being & Balance: Professional mental health support via OpenUp.

We welcome applications via our website from 25 August - 07 October 2026.

The International Max Planck Research School for Molecules of Life (IMPRS-ML) offers fully funded PhD student positions in the areas of biochemistry, structural biology, biophysics, cell biology, systems biology, and computational biology. We are looking for outstanding graduates from all over the world to join our network of passionate young scientists in Munich. CURRICULUM & TRAINING
IMPRS-ML offers high-level scientific training in a dynamic and international research environment with state-of-the-art facilities to doctoral researchers aiming for successful careers in science. Our comprehensive curriculum allows our students to tailor their learning to their interests, requiring them to earn 25-30 ECTS through various activities. Seminars, summer schools, retreats, elective courses, and participation in international conferences supplement their laboratory work.

JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
The strongest asset of our graduate program is our vivid and international research community. IMPRS-ML brings together two renowned Max Planck Institutes, the Max Planck Institute of Biochemistry (MPIB) and the Max Planck Institute for Biological Intelligence (MPI-BI), as well as two leading partner universities, the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) and the Technische Universität München (TUM), to deliver first-class training for the world’s most promising young scientists. Our graduate school comprises more than 250 PhD students from 40+ countries as well as 35+ distinguished and internationally recognised faculty members.
Applicants should hold an MSc (or equivalent degree) with a strong background in biological sciences, biochemistry, biophysics, biotechnology or a related discipline.
Outstanding applicants with a 4-years BSc hons (or equivalent degree) may be eligible to apply depending on the degree awarding country.

For more information, eligibility criteria and online application please visit our website:  https://imprs-ml.mpg.de/
